usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
usdRate.note: 2025 average; the IMF 2025 Article IV quotes VT 121.95 per dollar on 12 Aug 2025. RBV site unreachable.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics, Consumer Price Index June quarter 2026
inflation_cpi.note: National CPI up 1.2% on the June quarter of 2025 (1.4% on the quarter).

inflation_projection.sourceName: RBV inflation target range 0-4% (IMF 2025 Article IV); VBOS CPI history
inflation_projection.note: We plan with 3%, inside the RBV 0-4% target range and above recent 1% readings, because Vanuatu CPI has swung widely after cyclones and in 2022-2023.

policy_rate.sourceName: IMF 2025 Article IV staff report (RBV policy rate)
policy_rate.note: RBV policy rate unchanged at 2.75% since tightening in 2024Q3 (IMF, data to August 2025); RBV site was not reachable (certificate error), so a later change cannot be ruled out.

savings_account_rate.note: Bank savings rates are not published on the bank pages we could read, and RBV interest rate statistics were unreachable (certificate error).

fdr_3m_rate.note: Term deposits (1 month to 1 year) are sold, but no published rate could be read; RBV statistics unreachable.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Term deposits (1 month to 1 year) are sold, but no published rate could be read; RBV statistics unreachable.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or rate found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Vanuatu has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No treasury bills issued yet; the IMF 2025 Article IV says the government plans to issue T-bills for the first time.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Domestic government bonds exist (IMF: longer-term bonds yield 7-9%), but we found no published 5-year yield.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Domestic government bonds exist (IMF: longer-term bonds yield 7-9%), but we found no published 10-year yield.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Agency, Low Tax Jurisdiction
tax_bank_interest.note: No personal income tax and no withholding taxes, so bank interest is untaxed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: Vanuatu Foreign Investment Promotion Agency, Low Tax Jurisdiction
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists; with no personal income tax, interest on government bonds is also untaxed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: We found no deposit insurance scheme in Vanuatu, but could not confirm it from an official page (RBV site unreachable).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in vatu terms
equity_return_low.note: Vanuatu has no stock exchange, so equity means foreign funds; a lost decade for global shares in vatu terms is the low case.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in vatu terms, capped at the safe rate plus 4 points
equity_return_base.note: No local market, so base is a global index in vatu terms, held to the assumed 1% safe rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index long-run return in vatu terms
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run global equity return with a stable basket-pegged vatu.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; basket-managed vatu (IMF 2025 Article IV)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade; the vatu is managed against a currency basket.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; basket-managed vatu (IMF 2025 Article IV)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% with little expected vatu depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; basket-managed vatu (IMF 2025 Article IV)
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case at the average deposit rate of 0.31%. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate; RBV policy rate (IMF 2025 Article IV)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case of 1%, between the 0.31% average deposit rate and the 2.75% policy rate, since term deposits pay more than the average. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near the policy rate, for savers who reach better term deposit rates. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio published; RBV insurance supervision pages unreachable.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Very small insurance market; no published term life premium rates or premium guide found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found; public hospital care is heavily subsidised.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)
oop_health_share.note: 8.4% for 2023, the latest World Bank value; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: VBOS CPI health sub-index, June quarter 2026
goal_inflation_health.note: Health CPI rose 11.1% in the year to June 2026 (private consultation and check-up fees), so we plan 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: VBOS CPI education sub-index, June quarter 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: Education CPI rose 7.8% in the year to June 2026 (school fees), so we plan 2 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.note: Men 69.9, women 74.5 (2026 estimate); secondary source. World Bank gives 71.7 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age (2026); secondary source.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL; UN WPP 2024 medium variant (via populationpyramid.net)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.6 in 2025 (World Bank), 9.5 in 2040 and 14.9 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Vanuatu National Provident Fund, Withdrawals (VNPF Act Cap 189)
retirement_age_default.note: Members can withdraw their savings at 55 (up to 50% at 47); there is no statutory pension age beyond this.

retirement_age_government.note: Public Service Act retirement age could not be read (PacLII blocked); not confirmed.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case at the average deposit rate. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: World Bank average deposit rate; RBV policy rate
retirement_return_base.note: Base case of 1%, kept modest because no 1-year deposit or bill rate could be confirmed. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

retirement_return_high.note: High case near the policy rate. Safe vatu rates: World Bank average deposit rate 0.31% (2025), RBV policy rate 2.75%, no tax on interest; published bank term-deposit rates could not be read; government bonds yield 7-9% but are sold in large lots and held mostly by the provident fund and RBV.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of vatu deposits and global equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case and 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of vatu deposits and global equity funds
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half global equity at 5% and half deposits near 1%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of vatu deposits, global equity and VNPF-style returns
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% higher-yield fixed income.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: We found no non-contributory old-age pension in Vanuatu, but could not confirm it from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: The Employment Act [Cap 160] provides a severance allowance, but we could not read the current text (PacLII blocked), so the days per year are not confirmed.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Vanuatu National Provident Fund, Withdrawals and Voluntary Membership pages
public_pension_scheme.note: VNPF is a provident fund: members withdraw their savings at 55 (up to 50% at 47); no annuity is described. Voluntary members can join from age 10 with VT 1,000 a month; interest is declared yearly.

fdr_3m.note: Banks offer terms from one month to one year.

fdr_1y.note: Banks offer terms from one month to one year.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bills yet; first issue planned (IMF 2025 Article IV).

tbond_5y.note: Domestic bonds are issued in large lots and held mainly by the provident fund and RBV; smaller lots are planned.

tbond_10y.note: Domestic bonds are issued in large lots and held mainly by the provident fund and RBV.

equity_fund.note: No stock exchange or locally sold retail funds; only foreign funds bought abroad.

gold.note: No local bullion dealers found; gold would have to be bought abroad.

insuranceRegulator.name: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (insurance supervision)
insuranceRegulator.note: RBV supervises insurers under the Insurance Act; site could not be read during research.

insuranceComplaints.name: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu
insuranceComplaints.note: No insurance ombudsman found; complaints go to the insurer, then the regulator.

pensionScheme.name: Vanuatu National Provident Fund (VNPF)
pensionScheme.note: Mandatory provident fund for employees; lump sum from age 55.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (public hospitals and health centres)
